source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: ("data commons" OR "data trust" OR "technological sovereignty" OR "digital sovereignty") AND (city OR urban)
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:("data commons" OR "data trust" OR "technological sovereignty" OR "digital sovereignty") AND (city OR urban),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has (("data commons" OR "data trust" OR "digital sovereignty" OR "technological sovereignty") AND ("city" OR "urban"))
